sources.set: units.jsonl: every included chunk of every chunked benchmark, text from the normalised text by offsets

candidates.terms: <every HECoS term and non-preferred term, keyed by HECoS code, as {code: {direct: [term, ...]}}, the benchmark's own default code removed per benchmark>
rules: read every unique hit in context before tagging

never own: generic vocabulary; QAA cross-cutting themes (recorded as theme mentions under D-0066); names of other benchmarks or neighbouring subjects; career and curriculum lists; same spelling in another sense
known limit: an elided shared noun ('clinical, educational ... psychology') can be missed; M1 against M2 is the check

judgement.states: own (with codes and extract); chunks with no own record are inherited

output.file: tools/subject/core/tags/<benchmark-slug>.json, one per benchmark, keyed by chunk id
